content.title: Search with an unmatched term or with no term and see the explicit no-results message
content.intent: Prove that both an unmatched search term and a blank submission resolve to the same explicit `No books match your search` message instead of an empty or broken results page.
content.technique_notes: Negative/error coverage plus equivalence partitioning for two source-defined no-results representatives: an unmatched non-empty term and a blank submission. Boundary value analysis applied to the blank submission as the source-stated minimum-content input. Risk-judged interaction strength was 2 because only user-reach applies, and no covering array was needed because the path varies a single input family whose representatives are documented to share one outcome.
